target.statement: Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) of 0.6545303 for PAM clustering using distance dCC on SyntheticData2

compute.basis: The target is a single ARI value from clustering 80 short synthetic series (T=600, 6 states) using the otsfeatures package; all data and functions are on CRAN, and the computation is trivial on a CPU.

title: Ordinal time series analysis with the R package otsfeatures
